components.name: Diagram/Timeline item
components.description: Vertical event history or roadmap (application status, delivery tracking, project milestones). Stack items; hide the Line on the last item. Done = status/success, Current = accent with soft ring and accent date, Upcoming = outline marker and muted title. For a numbered wizard use 4.17 Steps instead. React: <Timeline><TimelineItem state title date description /></Timeline>
